title: Sophia Baker — Family & Biography
body_markdown:
# Sophia (March) Baker (1829–1901)

**Born:** 1829 in Norfolk, England
**Died:** 1901 in South Australia

Daughter of [[Joseph March (1797–1883)]] and [[Sophia Webster]]. She emigrated to South Australia with her parents aboard the *Canton* in 1846.

She married [[William John Baker (1831–1919)]] and they had at least one daughter: [[Hannah Baker (1855–1948)]].
